title: Past and present thoughtbotters at LRUG this Monday
partialText: Come hear Ruby talks by Fritz Meissner and Ismael Celis at the London Ruby User Group meeting on Monday 13th July.

title: The Bike Shed Ep 505:  What is a “principal” or “staff” engineer?
partialText: Sally and Joël join forces to discuss the different ways to interpret the role of a ‘principle’ or ‘staff’ engineer, and the handwaving around what those titles mean in terms of the gradation.
